verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau lau an ras bas tau lau nahee prem ras jau lau aan dhiaan aap aap nahee dhekheeaai ||

en.bdb: So long a human being remains absorbed in worldly attractions and pleasures, he cannot know love. So long his attention is focused on something else, he cannot realize self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਅਧਯਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਿਸੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau lau aan giaan tau lau na adhayaatam giaan jau lau naadh baadh na anaahadh bisekheeaai ||

en.bdb: (Renouncing Lord) as long as one is busy acquiring knowledge of mundane worldly things, he remains bereft of spiritual wisdom. As long as one remains involved in worldly pleasures one cannot hear the unstruck celestial music of divine word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅਲਖ ਨ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau lau aha(n) budh sudh hoi na a(n)taragat jau lau na lakhaavai tau lau alakh na lekheeaai ||

en.bdb: As long as one remains proud and arrogant, one cannot realise self. Till such time True Guru does not initiate a person with the boon of Lord's name and propitiate the Lord, one cannot realise the 'formless God'.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭੇਖੀਐ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: sat roop sat naam sat gur giaan dhiaan ek hee anek mek ek ek bhekheeaai ||12||

en.bdb: The knowledge of Almighty lies in the consecrating words of the True Guru that leads one to reality of His name and form. By uniting his mind with His name, the Lord who prevails in various forms gets revealed. (12)
